Paragraph.Text: Commands are the primary way for your Leptos frontend to trigger logic in the Rust backend. They work similarly to an API endpoint in a web server.

If a command needs to perform I/O (like reading a file or calling an API), it should be
. Tauri automatically handles the async execution so that the main thread is not blocked.

#[tauri::command]
async fn fetch_remote_data(url: String) -> Result<String, String> {
    reqwest::get(url).await
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
        .text().await
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())
}
